title: 第11章 周天采气第12章 勇猛精进感谢水澜的盟主打赏
content_zh:
市中心的一座摩天大楼前。
张羽抬着头，望着那高耸入云，好似要洞穿天空的大厦，隐约能看到摩天大楼的顶部好像有一座仙宫隐约浮现。
这里便是仙韵集团在嵩阳市中心的办公大楼。
除此之外，张羽还能看到远处有一栋更高的巨楼，像是连接到了真正的天际尽头一样，他知道那是嵩阳市的第一高楼，据说有999层的中心大厦，也是他上下学路上经常看到的地标。
此刻，他再次转头看向了眼前的办公大楼。
“仙韵集团吗？”
来的路上张羽已经在网上搜索了一番仙韵集团的相关资料。
这是万法宗门下的一家巨型企业，所经营的业务包括开发功法、售卖功法、仙道教育、图书文创等方面。
而万法宗便是十大宗门之一，在这个昆墟之中，从衣食住行到生老病死，人的一生都离不开十大宗门，仙道修炼就自然更是如此。
所以对于仙韵集团这样的巨企属于万法宗这个十大宗门门下，如今的张羽也毫不意外。
低头走进大楼，张羽在前台说明了来意之后，又陆续经过了登记、签合同和一通简单的体检，最后被引到了一处像是教室的地方。
便看到教室里除了他以外已经坐了几名学生。
又等待了一段时间，在教室里学生数目达到十五人之后，一名西装革履的中年男子走了进来，开始讲述起了今天的试功内容。
“大家好，我是今天的指导老师。”
“在场的各位都已经签过了合同，但我还是要提醒一下，今天我们在这里讲述的一切都不允许传播出去，一旦被我司发现有哪一位走漏了消息，那不论诸位跑到天涯海角，我们都一定会找到你。”
听着这番话的众多学生心中一凛，却知道对方所言不虚，以仙韵集团的实力，以及对方背后的万法宗，要做到这点确实不难。
“各位今天要尝试学习的功法，我们称呼为试验功法113号，接下来请大家先看一遍教学视频……”
按照教学短片中的介绍，这门功法是一门炼气境界的吐纳功法，但和基础吐纳法不同的点，在于这门功法要复杂了许多，就像是要在全身上下建立某种法力的循环一样。
以至于看完了教学视频之后，大部分来试功的学生仍旧是一头雾水。
直到在接下来指导老师的详细讲解中，众多学生们才隐隐有了一个大概的了解，却越发感觉到头皮发麻。

“不是……让我们练这种功法？我们配吗？”
实在是这门功法的运功路线太复杂，难度太高了，宛如是在一张4a纸上画清明上河图一样。
要让张羽来形容的话，就是这和屎上雕花一样难。
别说照着教学中的运功路线来运功了，在场众人根本连这运功路线都背不下来，几乎刚讲完就已经忘了大半。
别说传播了，对于接下来能不能练成这门武功完成试验，学生们都可谓是全无信心。
似乎是感受到了众多学生的情绪变化，指导老师在上方说道“各位放心，这次试验并不要求你们练成这门功法。”
“事实上初学者光靠自己，也是不可能练成这门功法的。”
“我们这次要测试的东西，还有与113相匹配的辅助运功设备……”
接下来，在场的众多学生们被送到了一处检测室，在双手、双脚还有胸口、后背等位置贴上了法力检测贴片。
然后一根根银针似的东西则连着线路，被机械臂送到了学生们的面前。
一旁的指导老师继续说道“当你们开始运功之后，检测贴片会时时监控你们体内法力运转的状况。”
“而元磁针则会在机械臂的操作下，在你们法力运转路线上进行刺激，辅助你们识别和纠正运功路线……”
张羽听了一会儿便明白了，就是个自动寻路……哦不，不自动寻功是吧。
因为这113功法的法力路线太过复杂，对于灵机和法力运转的时机、点位都要求太高，所以需要一边检测修炼者的运功路径，一边用元磁针刺激体内各部位来进行引导。
不过这个过程的危险却也不小，因为113功法的运功路线太过复杂。
如此复杂的运功路线下，一旦法力的运转路径稍有差错，便会引得法力失控，溢散体内，搅得体内又痒又疼，忽冷忽热，容易引起更大失控。
若是时间拖得久了，还将导致内伤，时间拖得越久，内伤便越是严重。
此后要么去医院以高价请强者以强横法力镇压伤者体内失控的法力，要么凭借**强度硬抗，等待法力自行耗尽散去，要么便是修炼者自身练成此功，以行功之法，去主动收束运功路线上失控散逸的法力。
与此同时，指导老师接着说道“……一切如各位所签的合同那样，这次试功的酬劳，将按照各位完成的运功路线占比来发放，只有走完100%的运功路线，才能获得完整的一万块。”
“如果法力只走了一半的话，那便只有五千了。”

“好了各位，如果没有问题的话，便请开始吧。”
张羽看了一眼浮现在羽书上的资料。
周天采气法0级（01）
他心中暗道“这意思只要练一遍就成了？”
content_en:
In front of a skyscraper in the city center.
Zhang Yu raised his head and looked at the towering building that seemed to penetrate the sky. He could vaguely see a fairy palace looming on the top of the skyscraper.
This is the office building of Xianyun Group in the center of Songyang.
In addition, Zhang Yu could also see a taller giant building in the distance, as if it was connected to the real end of the sky. He knew that it was the tallest building in Songyang City. It is said that it has 999 floors of the central building, which is also a landmark he often sees on his way to and from school.
At this moment, he turned his head again and looked at the office building in front of him.
"Xianyun Group?"
On the way here, Zhang Yu had already searched for relevant information about Xianyun Group on the Internet.
This is a giant enterprise under the Wanfa Sect. Its business includes developing and selling exercises, immortal education, book and cultural creation, etc.
The Wanfa Sect is one of the ten major sects. In this Kunxu, from food, clothing, housing and transportation to birth, old age, illness and death, a person's life is inseparable from the ten major sects, and this is especially true for the cultivation of immortality.
Therefore, Zhang Yu is not surprised that a giant company like Xianyun Group belongs to the ten major sects of Wanfa Sect.
Lowering his head and walking into the building, Zhang Yu explained his intention at the front desk, then went through registration, contract signing and a simple physical examination, and was finally led to a place that looked like a classroom.
Then he saw that there were several students sitting in the classroom besides him.
After waiting for a while, when the number of students in the classroom reached fifteen, a middle-aged man in a suit walked in and began to talk about today's test.
"Hello everyone, I am today's instructor."
"Everyone present has signed the contract, but I still want to remind you that nothing we tell here today is allowed to be spread. Once our company finds out that anyone has leaked the news, no matter where you go to the end of the world, we will definitely find you."
Many students who heard these words were shocked, but they knew that what the other party said was true. With the strength of the Xianyun Group and the Wanfa Sect behind the other party, it is indeed not difficult to achieve this.
"The exercise you are going to try to learn today is called Experimental Exercise No. 113. Next, please watch the teaching video first..."
According to the introduction in the teaching video, this exercise is a breathing and breathing method in the realm of qi refining, but the difference from the basic breathing and breathing method is that this exercise is much more complicated, as if it is to establish a certain kind of magic circulation throughout the whole body.
So much so that after watching the instructional video, most of the students who came to try it out were still confused.
It was not until the instructor's detailed explanation that followed that many students had a vague understanding, but their scalps became increasingly numb.
"No... let us practice this kind of skill? Are we worthy?"
It is true that the route of this exercise is too complex and too difficult, just like drawing the Riverside Scene during the Qingming Festival on a piece of 4a paper.
If Zhang Yu had to describe it, it would be as difficult as carving on shit.
Not to mention following the exercise route in the teaching, everyone present could not even memorize the exercise route, and almost half of it had been forgotten as soon as the lecture was finished.
Not to mention spreading it, the students have no confidence at all whether they can master this martial arts and complete the test.
As if sensing the emotional changes of many students, the instructor said from above, "Don't worry, this test does not require you to practice this technique."
"In fact, it is impossible for beginners to master this technique by themselves."
"What we want to test this time is the auxiliary exercise equipment that matches 113..."
Next, many students present were sent to a testing room, where mana testing patches were affixed to their hands, feet, chest, and back.
Then like silver needlesThe items were connected to the lines and sent to the students by the robotic arm.
The instructor on the side continued, "When you start exercising, the detection patch will constantly monitor the operation of mana in your body."
"The magnetic needle will, under the operation of the mechanical arm, stimulate the movement route of your mana, assisting you in identifying and correcting the movement route..."
After listening to it for a while, Zhang Yu understood that it was just an automatic path-finding... Oh no, it wasn't automatic path-finding, right?
Because the mana route of these 113 exercises is too complicated, and the timing and point of the spiritual movement and mana operation are too high, so it is necessary to detect the practitioner's movement path and use magnetic needles to stimulate various parts of the body for guidance.
However, the danger of this process is not small, because the route of 113 exercises is too complicated.
Under such a complex movement route, once there is a slight error in the path of mana, it will cause the mana to lose control and spill out of the body, causing itching, pain, and alternating cold and heat, which can easily lead to greater loss of control.
If the time is delayed for a long time, it will also cause internal injuries. The longer the time is delayed, the more serious the internal injuries will be.
After that, one can either go to the hospital and pay a high price to hire a strong person to use tyrannical magic power to suppress the out-of-control magic power in the injured person's body, or rely on physical strength to resist and wait for the magic power to be exhausted and dissipate on its own, or the practitioner can practice this skill himself and use the method of practice to actively restrain the out-of-control magic power on the movement route.
At the same time, the instructor continued, "...everything is as per the contract you signed. The rewards for this trial will be distributed according to the proportion of the exercise routes you complete. Only by completing 100% of the exercise routes can you get the full 10,000 yuan."
"If only half of the mana is gone, then there will only be five thousand."
"Okay everyone, if there are no questions, please start."
Zhang Yu glanced at the information that appeared on Yu's book.
Zhoutian gas extraction method level 0 (01)
He thought to himself, "Does this mean you only need to practice it once?"
